name: dev-workflow
description: Project workflow engine: scaffolds living documentation (.claude/ files), orchestrates agent teams for batch task execution, auto-splits large batches into subagent sessions, and standardizes verification/wrap-up phases. Includes ship, audit, and QA skills with git safety guardrails. v3: scaffold-generated hooks, framework-specific templates (Next.js/Go/Rust/FastAPI), 6-phase verification loop, PRP workflow, git history analysis, language-specific rules, role-based subagents, MCP health tracking. Modes: scaffold, execute, handoff, resume, audit, upgrade.
